name: Second Chance
when: After any of your darts has landed.

name: Triple Trouble
effect: Your first dart scores ×3. Your opponent's first dart next turn scores ×3 too.
when: Before your first dart of the turn.
limit: Can't be combined with other multipliers.

name: Double Trouble
effect: Your first dart scores ×2. Your opponent's first dart next turn scores ×2 too.
when: Before your first dart of the turn.
limit: Can't be combined with other multipliers.

name: Evens Only
effect: Your opponent's next turn: only even numbers score. Odd hits count as 0.

name: Odds Only
effect: Your opponent's next turn: only odd numbers score. Even hits count as 0.
limit: Can't be used if they need 40 or less.

name: Parity Lock
effect: Choose odd or even. For your opponent's next 2 turns only that type scores.
when: After your own throws, on your turn.
limit: Can't be used if they need 60 or less.
